def est(d):
    g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).y.mean().unstack()
    g=g.dropna(); return (g[1]-g[0]).mean()
def boot(d,B=1000):
    r=np.random.default_rng(0); out=[]
    gs=[x for _,x in d.groupby(['genre','late'])]
    for _ in range(B):
        out.append(est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=r.integers(1e9)) for x in gs])))
